content:
Enact Holdings has followed the market's trajectory closely, rising in tandem with the S&P 500 over the past six months. The stock has climbed by 17.3% to $47.26 per share while the index has gained 16.9%.

Is now the time to buy Enact Holdings, or should you be careful about including it in your portfolio? See what our analysts have to say in our full research report, it's free .

Why Do We Think Enact Holdings Will Underperform?

We don't have much confidence in Enact Holdings. Here are three reasons why ACT doesn't excite us, plus one stock we'd rather own.

1. Net Premiums Earned Hit a Plateau

When insurers sell policies, they protect themselves from extremely large losses or an outsized accumulation of losses with reinsurance (insurance for insurance companies). Net premiums earned are therefore gross premiums less what's ceded to reinsurers as a risk mitigation and transfer strategy.

Enact Holdings's net premiums earned was flat over the last five years, much worse than the broader insurance industry. This shows that policy underwriting underperformed its other business lines.

2. Projected Revenue Growth Shows Limited Upside

Forecasted revenues by Wall Street analysts signal a company's potential. Predictions may not always be accurate, but accelerating growth typically boosts valuation multiples and stock prices while slowing growth does the opposite.

Over the next 12 months, sell-side analysts expect Enact Holdings's revenue to stall, a slight deceleration versus its 2.7% annualized growth for the past two years. This projection doesn't excite us and implies its products and services will face some demand challenges.

Analyzing the long-term change in earnings per share (EPS) shows whether a company's incremental sales were profitable — for example, revenue could be inflated through excessive spending on advertising and promotions.

Enact Holdings's full-year EPS grew at a weak 4.4% compounded annual growth rate over the last four years, worse than the broader insurance sector.

Enact Holdings falls short of our quality standards. That said, the stock currently trades at 1.2× forward P/B (or $47.26 per share). 为什么我们认为 Enact Holdings 会表现不佳？

我们对Enact Holdings 没有太大信心。以下是 ACT 不让我们兴奋的三个原因，以及我们宁愿持有的一只股票。

1. 净保费收入达到稳定水平

当保险公司出售保单时，他们通过再保险（保险公司的保险）来保护自己免受巨大损失或巨额损失累积。因此，赚取的净保费是毛保费减去作为风险缓解和转移策略而分给再保险公司的保费。

Enact Holdings 的净保费收入在过去五年中持平，远低于整个保险行业。这表明保单承保的表现落后于其他业务线。

2. 预计收入增长空间有限

华尔街分析师预测的收入表明了公司的潜力。预测可能并不总是准确的，但加速增长通常会推高估值倍数和股价，而放缓增长则相反。

卖方分析师预计，未来 12 个月，Enact Holdings 的收入将停滞不前，与过去两年 2.7% 的年化增长率相比略有放缓。这一预测并不令我们兴奋，并意味着其产品和服务将面临一些需求挑战。

分析每股收益 (EPS) 的长期变化可以显示公司的增量销售是否有利可图，例如，广告和促销方面的过度支出可能会夸大收入。

过去四年，Enact Holdings 的全年每股收益复合年增长率仅为 4.4%，较整体保险业差。

Enact Holdings 未达到我们的质量标准。也就是说，该股目前的交易价格为 1.2 倍远期市净率（即每股 47.26 美元）。虽然这个估值是合理的，但我们目前并没有看到很大的机会。现在有优质股票可供购买。让我们向您推荐我们精选的最佳数字广告之一。
